Title: Ajay and the Family

Cast

1. Ajay - 34 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Shalini - 27 years, princess, daughter
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
3. Meenakshi - 64 years, queen, mother
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
4. Vinod - 38 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The training ground - an earth ground, a rack of weapons

Scene 1: The training ground - Day

[Ajay stands on the training ground. Shalini and Meenakshi stand near him.]

Ajay: "What lovely weather!"

[Ajay practises sword fighting.]

Ajay (laughing): "Careful!"

[Ajay mounts his horse and gallops away.]

Ajay (excited): "This is amazing!"

[Shalini rides into the training ground on her horse.]

Shalini (gently): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
